documentation.bandSize: Ranks per band. A rank-up that lands on the first rank of a band is a hyper trial; every other rank-up is a vessel trial
documentation.bandNames: Band names in ladder order, one per band. Medallion registry paths, rank badges and band colours all derive from these
documentation.thresholds: Greed reputation needed to hold each rank, rank 1 upwards. The list must hold one entry per rank of the ladder
documentation.godLevelGates: God alignment level needed with any single god before the rank-up trial for that rank may be taken, keyed by the rank being climbed to. Ranks with no gate are omitted
